decide.ruby: ThinkThen::Client.open { |client| p client.decide("Is this a complaint?", "I demand a refund today").value }

choose.ruby: ThinkThen::Client.open { |client| p client.choose({choose: "Which team owns this?", options: ["the refund desk", "the maybe desk", "anywhere else"]}, "please route this ticket").value }

tag.ruby: ThinkThen::Client.open { |client| p client.tag({tag: "Which words appear?", labels: ["refund", "shipping"]}, "the refund and the shipping").value }

score.ruby: ThinkThen::Client.open { |client| p client.score({score: "How urgent is this?", levels: ["Routine.", "Soon.", "Immediate."]}, "maybe later").value }

filter.ruby: ThinkThen::Client.open { |client| p client.filter("Is this a complaint?", ["good morning", "I demand a refund today"]).value }

rank.ruby: ThinkThen::Client.open { |client| p client.rank("Is this a complaint?", ["good morning", "I demand a refund today"]).results.map { |one| [one.input, one.answer.probability] } }

find.ruby: ThinkThen::Client.open { |client| p client.find("Which line asks for money back?", ["good morning", "I want a refund"]).value }

files.form.json: {"version":1,"questions":{"refund":{"decide":"Does the customer ask for a refund?"},"complaint":{"decide":"Is this a complaint?","threshold":0.5}}}

recognize.ruby: ThinkThen::Client.open { |client| p client.recognize({version: 1, recognize: {kinds: {person: nil, organization: nil, place: nil}}}, "Maria Chen joined Northwind Freight in Chicago last spring.").results.flat_map { |one| one.value.entities.map { |entity| [entity.text, entity.kind] } } }

relate.ruby: ThinkThen::Client.open { |client| p client.relate({version: 1, relate: {relations: [{name: "caused_by", source: "alert", target: "alert", either: false}]}}, [{name: "Checkout returns 500 at the payment step.", kind: "alert"}, {name: "The payments database ran out of disk space.", kind: "alert"}]).value.map { |one| [one.relation, one.source.name, one.target.name, one.probability] } }
relate.expected: [["caused_by", "Checkout returns 500 at the payment step.", "The payments database ran out of disk space.", 0.9], ["caused_by", "The payments database ran out of disk space.", "Checkout returns 500 at the payment step.", 0.9]]
